resources.string: Open NodeSeek posts and profiles from external apps directly in SeekTop. Other URLs use your previous default browser. No extension is needed. Links clicked within a browser remain in that browser.
Ready: select SeekTop Links for HTTP and HTTPS in Windows Default apps
Unable to complete. Check that your previous browser is available: %1$s
When off, all URLs are forwarded to your previous browser. To restore system associations, select that browser again in Windows Default apps.
Open external NodeSeek links in SeekTop?

Open NodeSeek posts from external apps in SeekTop; other URLs keep using your previous browser. You must select SeekTop Links for HTTP and HTTPS in Windows. You can skip and enable it later in Settings. This prompt appears only once.
